meta.requirement: Explore Stormbearer Mountains (1%+ exploration) to trigger this quest.

customTabs.label: tip
customTabs.content:
You can click the '''Collapse''' button and the '''Best Route''' → '''Important Only''' button at the top to minimize it.
''Some quests will not have a Best Route choice, because the best choice is subjective or not yet found.''

You can also click the '''Endings''' button at the top to view all possible endings, and clicking an ending will show the options needed to reach that ending.

start.title: Rumors on the Wind
start.text:
''The wind up here has teeth.''

''You are still catching your breath from the climb when you hear it: a low, almost subsonic hum, somewhere between a vibration and a chord. Not the mountain wind. Something deliberate.''

''Three Anemo Slimes float in a tight cluster on a rocky ledge fifteen paces ahead. Their transparent bodies pulse in rapid sequence, one after another, like they are passing something between themselves. Talking.''

''They have not noticed you yet.''

get_closer.text:
''You take three steps. On the fourth, a loose pebble skips off the ledge.''

''All three slimes rotate simultaneously.''

''For a moment, nothing. They regard you with absolute stillness. Their vibrations cease. And in that moment of quiet, you catch something, a last frequency bleeding off the nearest one before it stops. Not sound. Not language. But something your mind assembles into shape anyway.''

''Storm-eye. The summit. It breathes.''

''Then the nearest slime expands to twice its size and slams a gust of air into your face. They do not want you to have heard that.''

stand_ur_ground.text:
''All three are spinning now, orbiting each other in a tight formation. Building pressure. Whatever they were whispering about, they have decided you are not leaving with it.''

''The wind on the peak goes from cold to cutting.''

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Defeat the three Anemo Slimes on the Stormbearer peak

continues.label: Do /rpg again and click Confront the Slimes. Defeat 3 [[Anemo Slime]]s

killed_slimes.text:
''The last one bobs a handspan above the ground. Its usual buoyancy is gone, the form slack and half-deflated. It hovers there, trembling.''

''Then, slowly, it lets out one long, low exhalation. A final vibration. In it you catch the same shape as before, fainter now, fraying at the edges. Storm-eye. Summit. Ancient. Then one more fragment, new, that you have not heard until now.''

''Sleeping.''

''The slime drifts sideways off the ledge and disappears below the ridgeline. The other two are already gone.''

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Reflect on the secret the Anemo Slimes were guarding at the Stormbearer summit

think_thru.text:
''You stand alone on the peak. The wind up here moves differently than it does in the valley. It has direction. Intent.''

''The slimes were not guarding territory. They rushed you only after they realized you had heard them. They were guarding a secret about something they named, as near as you can translate it: the eye in the storm.''

''Old charts from the Adventurers' Guild flag a persistent vortex near this summit. Navigational hazard. Anomalous Anemo concentration at odds with the surrounding weather patterns. It has been there as long as the maps have existed. It does not disperse. It does not move. The Guild's notes call it atmospheric. Local miners called it the Eye of the Mountain. The slimes called it sleeping.''

''Something is here. At the summit. And it has been here a long time.''

choices.label: Mark the location in your notes

eye_that_breathes.title: Eye That Breathes
eye_that_breathes.text:
''You mark the summit coordinates. The Adventurers' Guild chart is not wrong, technically, but it is not complete. A dormant Hypostasis is not a weather anomaly. It is a living construct of pure elemental force. Anemo, from the look of the vortex. Dormant, according to the slimes.''

''But Hypostases do not stay dormant forever.''

''You fold the notes away.''

''Whenever it wakes, you will be ready.''
